# Cluster 11: Neural-net approximation theory

4 papers · years 1989–2019 · 2 curated

## Top authors

- Hornik (1)
- Gao (1)
- Yadav (1)
- Zhao (1)

## Key papers (by citations)

- **Hornik 1989** — [Multilayer feedforward networks are universal approximators](https://doi.org/10.1016/0893-6080(89)90020-8)  
  - Deep Learning: “Multilayer feedforward networks are universal approximators” (Hornik, 1989) 2.
- **Gao 2019** — [Dendritic Neuron Model With Effective Learning Algorithms for Classification, Approximation, and Prediction](https://doi.org/10.1109/tnnls.2018.2846646)  
  - Introduces a dendritic neuron model with nonlinear synapses trained by six metaheuristic algorithms (biogeography-based optimization, particle swarm, genetic algorithm, ant colony, evolutionary strategy, population-based incremental learning), outperforming a multilayer perceptron across 14 classification, approximation, and prediction tasks — a biologically motivated unit for practical machine learning rather than a systems-level motor model.
- **Yadav 2007** — [Time series prediction with single multiplicative neuron model](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.asoc.2006.01.003)
- **Zhao 2009** — [PSO-based single multiplicative neuron model for time series prediction](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2008.01.061)
